topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I walk the familiar path, each step measured, the air thick with the scent of earth and the occasional whisper of a leaf. My heart beats a rhythm against my chest, a drum in the silence. The woods, once a sanctuary, now seem to watch me with a thousand unseen eyes. I pause, the world holding its breath. A rush of wind carries the distant sound of a voice, or perhaps it’s just the trees. I quicken my pace, the path now uneven underfoot, the world closing in. The boundary between safety and threat blurs, and I find myself steering clear of shadows that once held no fear.
